body:
# Ceketrum Enough Items (CEI)

**Ceketrum Enough Items (CEI)** is a sleek, lightweight, and highly optimized recipe and item viewer designed for modern Minecraft. Built from the ground up for next-generation performance, CEI replaces clunky, outdated layout textures with a surgical, minimal **Flat Dark Mode** interface that keeps you focused on your game.

---

## 🎨 Current Features

* **Sleek Flat Dark UI:** A modern, distraction-free user interface featuring crisp typography, thin borders, and a high-contrast dark palette designed to look like premium developer tools.
* **Core Recipe Viewing:** Smooth and responsive item indexing, search bar, and basic crafting recipe displays.
* **Lightweight & Fluid:** Engineered for maximum performance to prevent interface stuttering, even in heavy, technical modpacks.
* **Favorites System:** Easily bookmark and organize your most-used items.

---

## 🔮 Coming Soon (Active Development)

We are actively working on making recipe management much smarter. Upcoming updates will include:
* **Multi-Window Pinning:** The ability to pin multiple recipe windows on your screen simultaneously so you never lose track of complex crafting chains.
* **Quick-Crafting Integration:** Seamless item transfer buttons directly within your pinned layout.

---

## 🛠️ Current Status: Beta Release

This project is currently in its **early Beta phase**. 
At this stage, CEI operates as a clean, reliable alternative to standard item viewers with a focus on UI/UX redesign. Advanced custom features and deep mod integrations are still being implemented.

> 💡 **Feedback Welcome:** If you encounter any graphical anomalies, edge-case bugs, or have suggestions, please drop by our community channels to let us know!

---
